evals.prompt: Evaluate a changed skill inside an existing agentic project.
evals.expected_output: The durable test spec stays in the skill, while generated results use a separate canonical workspace.
assertions: Keeps evals/evals.json as the durable test specification.
Uses a separate workspace with the canonical with_skill and old_skill run layout.

evals.prompt: Evaluate a changed skill without an agentic project.
evals.expected_output: The durable test spec stays in the skill, while generated results use a separate canonical workspace.
assertions: Keeps evals/evals.json as the durable test specification.
Uses a separate workspace with the canonical with_skill and old_skill run layout.

evals.prompt: Maintain tracked eval specifications and benchmark history in a repository.
evals.expected_output: The durable test spec remains tracked, while generated runs use the canonical workspace layout.
assertions: Keeps evals/evals.json as a tracked skill asset.
Uses a separate workspace for generated runs.
Uses the canonical per-run and iteration-level report layout.
